changes.title: Trump denies U.S. running low on some munitions, says vast resupplies being made
changes.summary: President Trump is taking issue with recent reports of significant U.S. munitions shortages due to the war with Iran.

changes.title: Morning news brief
changes.summary: Iran says it's close to a deal with Oman over navigation on the Strait of Hormuz, a look at the challenges both candidates for Michigan's U.S. Senate seat will face, Trump touts U.S. economy in Vegas.

changes.title: Iran Hormuz Deal Advances Amid US Munitions Supply Questions
changes.summary: A deal on the Strait of Hormuz could come as early as Thursday, with the Iranian foreign ministry saying a draft agreement between Iran and Oman is under review. It comes as there are new concerns over a potential shortage of U.S. weaponry. NBC’s Keir Simmons reports for TODAY.

changes.title: Suspected Iran Cyberattacks on U.S. Water Supply Follow Years of Warnings and Neglect
changes.summary: Federal and state officials are racing to address an assault on the nation’s water supply that they believe is the work of Iranian hackers.

changes.title: News Wrap: Senate confirms Dr. Erica Schwartz as CDC director
changes.summary: In our news wrap Wednesday, the Senate confirmed Dr. Erica Schwartz as the new director of the CDC, FAA officials are investigating an incident involving President Trump's helicopter and a commercial aircraft, Iran says it's in the final stage of drafting a deal with Oman that would reopen the Strait of Hormuz and UK a.

changes.title: Trump says deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz could come as early as Wednesday
changes.summary: Iran and Oman inched toward an agreement on the critical waterway that could ease pressure on the global economy and potentially help bring an end to the war.

changes.title: Trump claims Strait of Hormuz deal could happen soon as Iran and Oman engage in talks
changes.summary: President Trump told reporters "a lot of progress had been made" on reopening the Strait of Hormuz and suggested a deal could be announced as early as Wednesday. CBS News' Natalie Brand has the details.

changes.title: Houthis Threaten to Expand Red Sea Attacks, and Claim Strikes on Saudi Tankers
changes.summary: Saudi Arabia has not commented on the claims by the Houthis, who are backed by Iran and have vowed to close “all access routes” to Saudi oil shipments.
